faqs.q: Sec. 38-63. - Emergencies and weather related events.
faqs.a:
Noise caused in the performance of emergency work for the immediate safety, health,
               or welfare of the community or individuals of the community, or to restore property
               to a safe condition in response to hazards involving public safety concerns shall
               not be subject to the provisions of this chapter. Nothing in this section shall be
               construed to permit law enforcement, ambulance, fire, snow plows, or other emergency
               personnel to make excessive noise in the performance of their duties when such noise
               is clearly unnecessary. Snow removal and other cleanup after weather related events
               necessary to remedy a safety hazard in compliance with Arvada City Code shall be exempt
               from the provisions of this chapter.
(Code 1981, § 19-13; Ord. No. 2208, § 1, 9-16-1985; Ord. No.
4789
, § 2, 12-6-2021)
Editor's note—
Ord. No.
4789
, § 2, adopted Dec. 6, 2021, changed the title of § 38-63 from "Emergencies" to read
               as set out herein.
